religions.name: Old Dunirr (Dwarven) Pantheon
religions.deity: Tulundusha, The Sad Horse of Ice

markers.name: Waford Fountain of Youth
markers.note: This legendary water source is whispered about in ancient tales and believed to possess mystical properties. The spring emanates crystal-clear water, shimmering with an otherworldly iridescence that sparkles even in the dimmest light.

markers.name: Kinbiralar — silver mining town
markers.note: Kinbiralar is a mining town of 5100 people just nearby the silver mine.

markers.name: The Peaceful Swan
markers.note: A big and famous roadside inn. Delicious mashed chevon with bright nectar is served here.

markers.name: Nulnalbarad Waterfall
markers.note: The rapids of an exceptionally beautiful waterfall.

markers.name: Dungeon
markers.note: Undiscovered dungeon. See One page dungeon

markers.name: Alblereso Ogre
markers.note: Journeying folk speak of a huge Ogre who inhabits Alblereso hills and attacks unsuspecting victims.

markers.name: Hornby Stele
markers.note:

markers.name: Cataclysmic Rift
markers.note: A rumoured cataclysmic rift in this area is causing all known nearby beings to flee in terror.

markers.name: Disturbed Burial
